name: Leyden Capacitor Causeway

mystery_hook.visual_silhouette: Elevated copper viaducts lined with glowing blue glass capacitor bottles.
mystery_hook.unanswered_question: Where does the western grounding rail of Leyden Capacitor Causeway join Bellows Hearth?

causal_continuity.evidence: Serves as the western entry causeway of Thunder-Coil Basin along scar-brass-faultline.

fantasy_and_wonder.evidence: Elevated copper viaducts flanked by singing cyan glass Leyden-jar towers.
